entities.summary: Sidi M'Hamed is a municipality in Algiers Province, Algeria; formerly known as Mustapha. It is the seat of the district of the same name. Its municipal code is 1602 and postal code is 16014 and it has a population of 90,455 as of the 1998 census, which gives it 15 seats in the PMA.
